title: Pointer to the properties of [def-trf-global-operator]
text:
In the notation of [def-trf-global-operator], the following holds. I.e. $R\Gamma_c(Z,M)=\operatorname{Fib}_s(Ra_{Z!}M)$,
the assertion $R\Gamma_c(Z,M)\in D^b_{\mathrm{fin}}(A)$ for
$M\in D^b_{ctf}(Z,A)$ is
[prop-trf-compact-support-perfectness]),
